Container.Name: Prusa-Connect
Container.Overview: Self-hosted local Prusa Connect server for managing Prusa 3D printers on your LAN without relying on Prusa's cloud. Uses Prusa Research's official Docker image. First-time setup is completed in the browser. This Unraid template is independently maintained and not officially maintained by Prusa Research.
Container.Requires:
IMPORTANT - FIRST INSTALL: The official Prusa image runs as UID/GID 10001:10001. Unraid normally creates bind-mount folders as 99:100 (mode 755), which causes a permission-denied restart loop. BEFORE clicking Apply: review the actual host paths for /config/config.d, /data, /files, /storage and /tmp. In the Unraid terminal, create those specific directories and chown them to 10001:10001. Example when defaults are unchanged: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/prusa-connect/{config.d,data,files,storage,tmp} ; chown -R 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/prusa-connect/{config.d,data,files,storage,tmp} . If the directories exist already, stop the container first; never chown unrelated appdata. If you already clicked Apply and the container is restarting, stop it, correct the ownership, and start it again. See README for exact steps and custom-path guidance.
FIRST-RUN SETUP: After start, open Docker container logs and find setup_code=XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. Enter this one-time code in the WebUI. We recommend choosing Local Accounts and creating an administrator during the first-run wizard; choosing no sign-in closes initial setup without any local accounts, so adding one later is not straightforward. Select /storage for uploaded print files. Restart the container after completing the wizard. Keep the setup code private.
PORT: Default host and container port are both 8080/TCP. If 8080 is occupied (for example by qBittorrent), change the Host Port in Unraid, not the container port. No PUID/PGID environment settings are supported. Optional /config/config.yaml is NOT required; if needed later, mount it separately read-only.

Config.Name: WebUI / API / Printer Port
Config.Description: Host TCP port for the web interface, REST API, and printer connections; container port is 8080.

Config.Name: Configuration and Database
Config.Description: Writable first-run setup, authentication database, resource overlay and history. REQUIRED: Create this host directory and chown it to UID/GID 10001:10001 BEFORE clicking Apply. See Additional Requirements.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent application and extension data. Host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: Persistent application files. Host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Uploaded print files and local storage. Host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.

Config.Name: Temporary Files
Config.Description: Writable scratch space required by the read-only root filesystem; host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.
